gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-heebo: Expressive and a bit artful, Bushcraft spaces its characters far apart and lets capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Heebo, a plain sans, stands tall and leaves its curves open, so the two feel like a loud mood settling into easy conversation.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-guntur: Wiry, wide-spaced and a little strange, Bushcraft runs its curves like a steel cable outline. Hind Guntur, a plain sans with open curves and tall lowercase like stamped metal, would read steadily and plainly through a long page.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-madurai: Bushcraft stretches its letters wide, with closed curves and no weight shifts at all. Hind Madurai, a sans-serif with s curves opening at both ends and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, makes a relaxed, approachable counterweight to that quirky spacing.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru is a sans whose lowercase tops press close to the ascender height, and each a keeps its mouth ajar. Under Bushcraft, it would read smoothly for pages.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-siliguri:
Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray line, its rounds slightly cracked open.

Under Bushcraft's closed, widely spaced display letters, this plain sans would read gently and steadily, with a small bump up into capitals.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-vadodara:
Hind Vadodara is a plain sans with open rounds and tall bowls.

Bushcraft is the one for artistic, widely spaced display letters with closed shapes, while Hind Vadodara does its best work in uniform thickness and spacious terminal gaps.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-huninn: Huninn is a plain sans whose s terminals stay clear of the body and whose lowercase climbs close to cap height. And Bushcraft, with its closed, widely spaced display letters, gives the page an artistic front while Huninn carries the text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight reads like bent tubing, with short ascenders barely above the lowercase and curve tails held back from the body. Bushcraft sits against it like a loud neighbor.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-karla: Bushcraft's curves never change weight, and its wide-spaced capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Karla, a sans-serif with a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall it looks stocky, makes the strongest contrast to that closed, artistic heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-kedebideri:
Kedebideri reads with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open and inviting.

Bushcraft, expressive and widely spaced with no thin strokes to vanish, sets the artistic tone while this plain sans carries the words beneath it.
